about_short_description.short_description: UpKeep is a platform developed for technicians and maintenance workers that provides them with a computerized maintenance management system.

product.name: UpKeep Maintenance
product.description: A mobile CMMS for managing work orders, preventive maintenance, assets, parts, inventory, inspections, technician activity, and maintenance records.

product.name: UpKeep Enterprise Asset Management
product.description: An asset management system for tracking equipment throughout its lifecycle, from maintenance and operational history through longer-term reliability and asset planning.

product.name: UpKeep Edge
product.description: An industrial IoT monitoring solution that uses sensors to track equipment conditions such as temperature, vibration, and runtime and initiate maintenance actions when readings change.

product.name: UpKeep Safety
product.description: A health and safety management solution for recording incidents, permits, lockout/tagout procedures, inspections, and corrective actions alongside maintenance work.

product.name: UpKeep Learn
product.description: A frontline learning management solution that converts standard operating procedures and completed work records into structured training courses for maintenance and operations personnel.

product.name: UpKeep Nova
product.description: An AI assistant for maintenance and asset operations that can generate work orders, create custom applications and checklists, convert voice input into tasks, and identify issues in operational records.
